corridor_notes: The Guangxi Gas Investment Engineering & Procurement (gigeps.com) project-announcement page for '广西天然气支线管网项目南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程' states the line starts at '西气东输二线南宁-百色支线工程吴圩分输清管站' (the Wuxu distribution/pigging station on PipeChina's West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2, Nanning-Baise branch), located in Jiangnan District, Nanning, and ends at '扶绥-崇左支线扶绥清管站围墙外 2m' (2m outside the perimeter wall of the Fusui pigging station on the Fusui-Chongzuo branch), Fusui County, Chongzuo. Route runs '沿线途经南宁市江南区及崇左市扶绥县' (Jiangnan District, Nanning through to Fusui County, Chongzuo). Stated length ~19.50 km (vs GEM's 20.00 km -- close, plausible planning-estimate vs as-built rounding), diameter D355.6mm (exact match to GEM's Diameter), design pressure 6.3MPa (exact match to GEM's Pressure), L360M ERW steel pipe. No major river/rail/highway crossings noted, but the filing flags 'san chuan' (three types of minor crossings) in its construction scope.
researcher_notes: This resolves the pilot pass's EXISTENCE concern: all 4 of GEM's originally-cited refs were dead/unreachable/empty, but an independent project-announcement page on gigeps.com (Guangxi's official gas-infrastructure-investment engineering & procurement portal) names the identical project ('广西天然气支线管网项目南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程') and independently corroborates Diameter (355.6mm, exact) and Pressure (6.3MPa, exact match to the sheet's cited-but-dead fgw.nanning.gov.cn values), plus a length (~19.5km) very close to GEM's 20km. Additional corroboration: a DuckDuckGo search also surfaced two Guangxi Water Resources Department (slt.gxzf.gov.cn) filings referencing the identical project name for its soil-and-water-conservation plan, but both slt.gxzf.gov.cn URLs are unreachable from this sandbox (ECONNREFUSED, same geo-block pattern as fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) and have no Wayback snapshot obtainable right now (archive.org rate-limited this session) -- not used as refs, but their existence (real government agency, real project name) further supports this segment being genuinely real, not phantom. On the pilot's DUPLICATE concern vs P4725 ('Fusui County->Guangxi', 83km, same diameter 355.6mm/capacity 0.85bcm/y, status=construction): this newly-found source describes P7654 as tapping the West-East Line 2 (Nanning-Baise branch) at Wuxu and terminating just outside the Fusui pigging station on a *separate* named corridor ('扶绥-崇左支线', the Fusui-Chongzuo branch) -- i.e. P7654 (Wuxu->Fusui, ~19.5-20km) reads as a distinct feeder segment INTO the Fusui pigging station, while P4725 (83km, under construction) is plausibly further downstream on that same Fusui-Chongzuo branch corridor, not the same physical pipe. Shared diameter/capacity across two segments of one corridor network is unsurprising (same design spec applied network-wide) rather than evidence of a relabeled duplicate. Not setting duplicate_of, but flagging this reasoning for human side-by-side review since I could not obtain the Fusui-Chongzuo branch's full alignment to rule it out with certainty.
